About dates and companies

Document dates come from the document itself or an explicit statement in its description. The Reforge publication date, document date, and index review date are separate fields. Dates that could not be established are marked accordingly.

Include years in titles expands the year filter to materials with a year such as 2022 in their title. These years are labeled separately and are not treated as verified publication dates.

An author company is an affiliation reported by Reforge. It is stored separately from the company where a material was created or to which it relates. Sources are linked in the details.

About the topic groups

The library is grouped into 17 disciplines by professional task, using titles, descriptions, and, for Guides, outcomes and steps. Ambiguous entries have reviewed primary disciplines. The table shows the primary discipline; related disciplines are available in the details and through the filter. These groups are my classification, not official Reforge tags.
